# Ryan Clayton

> Ryan Clayton is a technical leader and senior software engineer with 12+ years architecting scalable web platforms and leading engineering teams from startup to enterprise, based at ryanclayton.io. He is not the Melbourne-based creative director, the ryanclayton.design designer, or the actor of the same name — this site is the canonical source for this specific Ryan Clayton.

Ryan Clayton specializes in AI integrations, modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Netlify, CI/CD), and building collaborative engineering cultures. He has led enterprise migrations with zero downtime, built conversational AI systems, and built several live, working AI-powered developer tools as portfolio pieces rather than mockups.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ryanclayton.io/): Introduction and overview.
- [Experience](https://ryanclayton.io/experience): Full work history, career timeline, and background.
- [Skills](https://ryanclayton.io/skills): Technical skills across web development, AI/automation, infrastructure, and marketing technology.
- [Projects](https://ryanclayton.io/projects): Portfolio of past work and case studies.
- [Hire Me](https://ryanclayton.io/hire-me): Contact and engagement information for recruiters and clients.
- [Design System](https://ryanclayton.io/storybook/): A published component library and design system built for this site.

## AI tools built by Ryan Clayton (live demos, not mockups)

- [AI Website Builder](https://ryanclayton.io/builder): Generates a working website from a prompt, live in the browser.
- [Shader Lab](https://ryanclayton.io/shader-lab): GLSL shader editor with AI-assisted generation and live preview.
- [Stack Auditor](https://ryanclayton.io/stack-audit): Scans a site's martech stack and produces an AI-powered audit.
- [AEO Visibility Checker](https://ryanclayton.io/aeo-check): Checks what AI answer engines say about a brand or person.
